_comment: Flow-rate study 2026-08-08: find the reclaim/feedlime rates that meet the FIRM targets and minimize unsellable surplus, with the real operating hours (zone 1.1: 2000 h, zones 1.2/1.3: 7500 h, availability 80%) and the measured feed curve. Result: reclaim ~53 t/h, feedlime ~19 t/h -> KFS 86 kt, AgLime 131 kt (under the 135 kt cap), grits 40.6 kt, fines surplus ~4.9 kt.
